description: This file contains code generation logic for unboxing wrappers in PyTorch, converting boxed operator arguments from stack to unboxed kernel arguments using C++ code templates and argument conversion functions.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the unambiguous name of a NativeFunction.

methods.name: convert_arguments
methods.description: Converts all arguments of a NativeFunction to C++ code and bindings.

methods.name: argumenttype_ivalue_convert
methods.description: Converts a type argument to C++ code for unboxing, handling base, optional, and list types.
